item.title: CapitaLand Ascendas Reit buys two Singapore industrial assets and Japan data centre for $1.4 bil
item.description: CapitaLand Ascendas Reit (CLAR) has announced the acquisition of three industrial assets across Singapore and Japan for $1.4 billion. Two of the assets are in Singapore. CLAR is buying a 100% stake in 25 Loyang Crescent, a cluster of ramp-up logistics and industrial buildings, for $504.2 million, including an upfront land premium of $46.35 million. item.title: Savills appoints senior director for strategic research and advisory for Apac capital markets
item.description: Nicholas Wilson has been appointed as senior director for strategic research and advisory for capital markets, Asia Pacific (Apac), at Savills. He will be based in Singapore, reporting to Neil Brookes, Savills’ head of capital markets, Apac. According to the firm, Wilson will combine market research with transaction execution in this newly created role. item.title: A five-room flat along Boon Tiong Road was just sold for $1.649 million, marking a new record-high for such flats in Bukit Merah
item.description: A five-room HDB flat at 9A Boon Tiong Road was recently sold for $1.649 million ($1,368 psf), setting a new record high for such flats in Bukit Merah. Located on the 25th to 27th storeys, the 1,206-sq ft flat has a long remaining lease of around 89 years, which could have contributed to its eye-watering price. item.description: Eight strata retail units located on the ground floor of Plus, an office building at 20 Cecil Street, are being launched for sale via expression of interest (EOI) with CBRE appointed as its exclusive marketing agent.
